verdict.rationale: LM Studio is a local-model runtime and server platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence only shows client-side MCP support (installing and connecting MCP servers for use with local models), which belongs to a separate story and cannot be credited here. Nothing shows LM Studio exposing its own MCP server for external agents; its documented interfaces are OpenAI-like endpoints, a REST API and the lms CLI.
